# Lumenfold Q4 2026 Company Plan

Owner: Priya Natarajan. Last updated: Oct 5, 2026. Review cadence: Monday leadership sync.

We start Q4 at $2.31M ARR with 23 months of runway and 12 people. The quarter has one job above all others: close the Series A without dropping a customer. Every goal below has a single owner and a date. If a goal has no owner, it is not going to happen.

## Goals for Q4

| # | Goal | Owner | Due | Tracked in |
|---|------|-------|-----|------------|
| G1 | Close the Series A (target $14M) with first close before Thanksgiving | Priya | Nov 30 | Series A data room checklist |
| G2 | Zero silent failures on nightly runs: chunked matching for every tenant plus a zero-exception alert | Dmitri | Nov 15 | LUM-431 |
| G3 | Renew Kessler & Moore (renewal date Dec 1) with SAML SSO delivered as a committed deliverable | Marcus (SSO), Hannah (renewal) | Nov 20 | PR #1201 |
| G4 | Ship region-scoped roles for Ortega Foods and remove the temporary all-access setting before their year-end audit | Dmitri | Nov 16 | LUM-447 |
| G5 | Start SOC 2 Type II: pick the audit firm, sign the engagement letter, and begin the observation window on Dec 1 | TBD | Nov 30 | (none yet) |
| G6 | Hire a founding product designer and two senior backend engineers | Priya | Dec 15 | Hiring plan |
| G7 | Exit the year at $2.6M ARR (net new $290k: K&M uplift, Ortega region 2, Brightwater expansion) | Priya, Hannah | Dec 31 | Stripe + billing export |

## Notes on G5 (SOC 2 Type II)

We have the Type I report (dated Jun 14, 2026). Every serious buyer and the Series A lead will now ask for Type II. We received two quotes in September:

- Halden & Pryce (did our Type I): $41,000, 6-month window, fieldwork in June 2027.
- Cobalt Assurance: $36,500, 6-month window, includes a readiness review in December.

Budget assumes $38,000 in 2027 opex. Neither quote has been accepted. Scope (which systems, which subprocessors) needs a decision from engineering before the letter can be signed. If the window does not start Dec 1, the report slips past June and lands after the Kessler & Moore and Tidepool renewals.

## Things we are explicitly not doing in Q4

- No self-serve tier. Northmoor asked about it in the deep dive; the answer is 2027 H2 at the earliest.
- No EU data residency. We stay in us-west-2 only.
- No new outbound sales hire until after close.

# Security and compliance answers

Owner: Dmitri Okafor. This is the source of truth for questionnaires, customer security calls and investor diligence. Check here before asking in a channel. Last updated: Oct 27, 2026.

## Certifications

1. **SOC 2 Type I.** Yes. Report dated Jun 14, 2026, auditor Halden & Pryce. Shared only under NDA (mutual NDA template: Legal / Templates / Mutual NDA v3, Calloway Reed approved).
2. **SOC 2 Type II.** Not yet engaged. Planned observation window: Dec 1, 2026 to May 31, 2027, subject to auditor selection. Official customer answer: "Type II observation window planned to begin in December 2026; report expected mid-2027." Do not promise a Q1 report.
3. **ISO 27001.** No plans in 2027.

## Data protection

4. Hosting: AWS us-west-2 only. No EU region; we do not offer EU data residency.
5. Encryption in transit: TLS 1.2+ everywhere.
14. Encryption at rest: AES-256 via AWS KMS for primary storage (RDS), RDS automated snapshots and manual backups, and S3 (SSE-KMS). Backups are encrypted at rest, yes.
15. Backup retention: 35 days for RDS snapshots; nightly logical dumps kept 90 days.
16. Customer data deletion after termination: within 60 days, certificate on request.

## Testing

21. Penetration test: last external test by Redfern Security, completed Sep 18, 2025. Summary letter available under NDA. Next test: not yet booked.
22. Vulnerability scanning: weekly, Inspector + dependency scanning in CI.

## Healthcare

30. PHI: possible if customers upload lab or clinic vendor invoices. We have not signed a BAA with anyone yet. Any BAA template goes to Calloway Reed (Martin Feld) before signature.

## Identity and access

40. SSO for customers: SAML 2.0, IdP-initiated and SP-initiated, just-in-time provisioning (Business tier and up, from Nov 20, 2026). Mapped attributes: email (NameID), firstName, lastName, groups (optional, maps to Lumenfold roles).
41. SCIM: not yet.
42. Employee access: Google Workspace SSO + hardware keys for production.

## Subprocessors

AWS, Pipewell (warehouse), Stripe (billing only, no ledger data), Postmark (email). Changes announced 30 days ahead on the status page.

brightwater-retro.name: Retro: Brightwater nightly run failure (Oct 19)
brightwater-retro.content:
# Retro: Brightwater nightly run failure, Oct 19

Facilitator: Dmitri. Attendees: Dmitri, Jun, Marcus, Hannah, Priya. Date: Oct 30.

## What happened

Brightwater's US entity grew from 18k to 41k open lines after their September ERP migration. The matcher loaded all open lines into memory before scoring, crossed our hard 30-minute timeout at 4:12am Pacific, and exited as "succeeded" with zero matches. Their AP team came in at 7 to an empty exceptions queue and assumed everything had matched. It was the third failed run that month; the first two were retried silently by the scheduler.

## Timeline

- Oct 1 and Oct 9: runs time out; scheduler retry succeeds slowly; nobody notices.
- Oct 19, 4:12am: run times out with zero matches. 7:45am: Owen emails Priya and Hannah.
- Oct 19, 9:30am: Jun re-runs manually with the timeout raised to 90 minutes.
- Oct 21: exceptions queue (2,184 lines) confirmed by Owen.
- Oct 22: RCA draft. Oct 26: chunked matching on for Brightwater (11 minutes).
- Nov 1: recon_chunked on for all tenants.

## What went well

- Hannah had Owen on the phone within two hours.
- The chunking fix took 1.5 weeks, as estimated.
- Owen volunteered as a Series A reference call afterwards.

## What did not

- A "success" with zero matches on a large tenant was never treated as suspicious.
- Retries hid the first two failures.
- We had no idea which tenants were close to the line limit.

## Action items

| Action | Owner | Status |
|--------|-------|--------|
| Chunked matching with checkpoints (PR #1192) | Dmitri | Done |
| Zero-exception alert for tenants with >1k open lines | Dmitri | Done |
| Index on (tenant_id, run_id) for the checkpoint table | Jun | Done |
| Route the zero-exception alert to the customer's AP distribution list as well as ours | Dmitri | Not started |
| Late-run email to the customer when a run is 30+ minutes past its usual finish | Dmitri | Not started |
| Runbook for manual re-runs | Jun | Done |
| Add tenants above 30k open lines to the monthly volume review | Hannah | Not started |

escalation-process.name: Customer escalation process
escalation-process.content:
# Customer escalation process

Owner: Hannah Wu. Applies to every paying customer.

## Severity

- **Sev 1:** a nightly run failed or produced wrong results for a customer in close week, or any data exposure. Response: phone call to the customer within 1 hour, CEO informed immediately.
- **Sev 2:** degraded matching (auto-match rate down more than 10 points), a blocked user group, or a missed committed date. Response within 4 business hours.
- **Sev 3:** questions, how-to, feature requests. Response within 1 business day.

## Roles

- CS owner (Hannah or the account's CSM) runs the escalation and is the single voice to the customer.
- Engineering on-call (rotation in Trackline) owns diagnosis and the fix.
- Priya joins any Sev 1 call and any call where the customer's CFO is on the line.

## Steps

1. Acknowledge in writing, with the next update time.
2. Open a Trackline issue, link it in #customers.
3. Workaround first, fix second. Write down any workaround that loosens a control (for example temporary all-access) and set an end date.
4. Written RCA within 5 business days for every Sev 1.
5. **Within 24 hours of any customer call where we promise something, add it to the Customer commitments tracker with an owner and a date.**
6. Close the loop: confirm with the customer that the fix worked, then mark the commitment done.

## Templates

- RCA template: Customers / Templates / RCA.
- Customer update email: three sentences: what happened, what we are doing, when you will hear from us next.

## Recent escalations

- Brightwater, Oct 19 (Sev 1): RCA delivered Oct 23, accepted Oct 29.
- Ortega, Oct 23 (Sev 2): temporary all-access for Southwest clerks; end date: when LUM-447 ships.
